## Pre-merge checklist

<!-- Draft PRs may open before review. Complete this checklist before marking ready or merging. -->

- [ ] PR body contains `Closes #N` / `Fixes #N` / `Resolves #N` for every linked issue
- [ ] Squad-authored PR carries the `squad` label
- [ ] Required CI passes at the current head
- [ ] Current-head human approval or verified `squad/pre-pr-verdict` review record exists before merge
      (note: a squad record is self-attested agent review, not independent approval)
- [ ] Risk-routed review follows [canonical scope](copilot-instructions.md#risk-based-review-scope);
      stable findings and per-reviewer checkpoints preserve unresolved or overridden dissent
- [ ] Changes follow project conventions (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New warnings were not introduced (or are acceptable for this scope)
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated
